ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening at pre-incorporation filing stage of all UBOs, signatories, and authorized representatives against (i) the consolidated list maintained by the State Bank of Viet Nam, (ii) the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, (iii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) list, (iv) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and (v) Viet Nam's domestic sanctions and administrative measures. Real-time and periodic re-screening is required under Law No. 19/2022/QH15, Decree No. 96/2023/ND-CP, and Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN. Enhanced due diligence is triggered for all foreign politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates, and for any state-owned entity, official body, or sovereign wealth fund. A risk-based AML assessment, source-of-wealth declaration for funding contributions, and a written compliance sign-off by the designated AML compliance officer at the licensed Vietnamese entity are maintained in internal records.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng Thông Tin Quốc Gia về Đăng Ký Doanh Nghiệp) at www.dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, operated by the Business Registration Department under the Ministry of Planning and Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal name of a Vietnamese limited liability company must be written in the Vietnamese alphabet using Latin script and must contain the legal entity form 'Công ty TNHH' (Limited Liability Company), followed by a distinctive proper-name component. A foreign-language name, normally in English, may be simultaneously registered as long as the Vietnamese name is present and both scripts are transliterated in a manner not confusing to domestic counterparts. Logograms, non-Latin characters, and purely diacritics without standard Vietnamese orthography are not accepted. The name must not include previously registered names, confusingly similar designations, or reserved state and public-office vocabulary without the prior authorization of the competent ministry or sectoral regulator.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed company name, the applicant must access the National Business Registration Portal and file a corrected name proposal. The applicant may, within 03 working days after receiving the refusal decision, submit a written complaint to the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) that administers the enterprise registration. The DPI must render a decision within 15 working days. If the Director's decision remains adverse, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Minister of Planning and Investment for resolution, or initiate court proceedings under the Law on Administrative Procedures No. 24/2011/QH14. During the appeal, no separate name extension is available; the cleared name is valid for the completion of the initial incorporation dossier within 30 calendar days from preliminary acceptance.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for the registered head office of a foreign-invested limited liability company in Viet Nam. The registered office must be a physical premises within the territory of Viet Nam, with permanent right of use, accessible by authorities, and suitable for receiving official correspondence and producing documents for inspection. Mail-only virtual offices may support operational facilities but cannot satisfy the statutory registered-office requirement for a trading or market-making company that requires a State Securities Commission license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate elevated risk for a proprietary algorithmic high-frequency trading undertaking. Based on current enforcement practice, unannounced inspections before issuance of the enterprise registration certificate are rare; however, once the establishment dossier is filed, there is an estimated 30% probability of an on-site inspection by the Department of Planning and Investment or the State Securities Commission of Viet Nam within the first 12 months of business commencement, due to the sensitive financial services scope and the conditional licensing requirement.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 24-32 on incorporation, Articles 45-51 on limited liability company governance, Articles 75-77 on the Board of Members); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 22, 33-37 on Investment Registration Certificate and conditional market access); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (Articles 4-8, 21-25, 31-32); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP (Guidance on the Law on Investment, Appendix on conditional sectors including securities dealing); Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 and Decree No. 155/2020/ND-CP (Articles 142-147 on securities company licensing and charter capital); Circular No. 02/2019/TT-BKHDT (prescribed enterprise registration forms).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-run city where the head office is located; for enterprises in export processing zones, industrial zones and high-tech zones, the Management Board of the Export Processing and Industrial Zones (IZA); electronic filing through the National Business Registration Portal at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) under Form I-1 of Circular 02/2019/TT-BKHDT, submitted together with the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty, Form I-2), the List of Members (Form I-4), the notarized identity and legal-capacity documents of members, and the Investment Registration Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: General rule: no minimum charter capital is prescribed for a standard foreign-invested LLC under the Law on Enterprises. However, the registered business line of proprietary ultra-low-latency algorithmic market making is classified as securities dealing under ISIC 6499, a conditional business line requiring a Securities Company Establishment and Operation License; under Article 142 of Decree 155/2020/ND-CP the minimum charter capital for proprietary trading and for securities market making is VND 500,000,000,000 (five hundred billion Vietnamese Dong, approx. USD 20.5 million), or the aggregate of the applicable amounts if additional licensed services are registered. Charter capital must be fully contributed in cash in lawful convertible currency within 90 days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate date into a dedicated capital-contribution escrow account held at a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam, and the escrowed balance must be evidenced to the State Securities Commission before the operating license is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO FORMA FIRST BOARD OF MEMBERS RESOLUTION
Resolution No. 01/[YEAR]/HDTV of [Company Name] Limited Liability Company

The Board of Members of [Company Name] Limited Liability Company (the 'Company'), comprising all members duly convened on [Date] at the Company's registered office, hereby adopts the following resolutions:

1. CHARTER CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND CONTRIBUTION. Each member's subscribed charter capital shall be in the proportions set out in the Company Charter and the Register of Members. The total charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND 500,000,000,000 (five hundred billion Vietnamese Dong), being the statutory minimum for the licensed securities proprietary trading and market-making activities. Members resolve that the subscribed charter capital shall be paid in full within ninety (90) days of the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, through irrevocable wire transfers in lawful convertible currency into the Company's capital-contribution escrow account maintained at a bank licensed in Vietnam, each transfer referencing the contributing member's capital schedule.

2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE. The Company's registered and head office is established at [Street Address, Ward, District, City/Province, Viet Nam] as recorded in the Enterprise Registration Certificate and Company Charter. The General Director is authorized and directed to execute the office lease, to notify the Business Registration Office of the registered office adoption, and to effect all subsequent changes of address as may be required by law.

3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS. The Board appoints: (a) [Name] as Chairman of the Board of Members; (b) [Name] as General Director and legal representative of the Company; (c) [Name] as Chief Compliance Officer; and (d) [Name] as Chief Risk Officer, each appointment effective immediately and continuing until revoked by a subsequent member resolution. The General Director shall possess plenary powers to conduct the Company's business, to open and operate bank, clearing and broker accounts, to execute contracts, and to represent the Company before all Vietnamese governmental, regulatory and judicial authorities.

4. AUTHORIZATION OF FORMATION ACTS. The General Director, jointly with the Chairman, is authorized to prepare, notarize and file all documents required for the completion of the Company's formation and licensing, including the Investment Registration Certificate, Enterprise Registration Certificate, Securities Company Establishment and Operation License, tax registration, environmental registration, fire safety certification, seal registration, labor registration, exchange and clearing membership applications, and to engage legal counsel, notaries, independent auditors, IT consultants and other advisers for such purposes.

ADOPTED UNANIMOUSLY by the Board of Members at the first meeting held on [Date].

In witness whereof, the Chairman and the members affix their signatures.

______________________
Chairman of the Board of Members

______________________
Member

______________________
Member

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation: Obtain the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Agency of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city of the proposed head office, or the Management Board of the Export Processing and Industrial Zones (IZA) if the company is located in an EPE/IZ; e-submission via the National Foreign Investment Portal at https://dautunuocngoai.gov.vn.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor submits an investment project proposal and applies for the IRC under Articles 33-37 of the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14. Because securities dealing is a conditional market-access sector, the application must include a market-access compliance declaration confirming that foreign institutional investors may hold up to 100% charter capital of a licensed securities company in Vietnam. The DPI/IZA verifies the legality and financial capacity of the investor, the project objectives (proprietary route: ultra-low-latency algorithmic market making under ISIC 6499), and the proposed location, then issues the IRC within 15 working days of receipt of a complete and valid dossier. The IRC records the investment project code, investment capital, objectives, location, and duration and is the parent document for enterprise registration.
required_dossiers: Investment project proposal (Form A.I.1) describing the algorithmic market-making project and projected investment capital
Certificate of legal status of the foreign investor (certificate of incorporation or passport) notarized/legalized and consularized where required
Evidence of financial capacity of the investor (audited financial statements for the last financial year, or a bank confirmation of available funds)
Draft Limited Liability Company Charter approved by the investor(s)
Proposed registered office or project location confirmation (lease letter, or allocation decision of the IZA)
Market-access compliance declaration for the conditional securities sector
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the IRC application is queried or found incomplete, the DPI/IZA must issue a single written request for supplementation within 10 working days, and the investor has 30 days to cure the deficiencies; if the IRC is refused, the investor may file a complaint with the Chairman of the provincial People's Committee under the Law on Complaints (Law No. 02/2011/QH13) and thereafter initiate administrative court proceedings, or alternatively adjust the project scope and resubmit a revised Form A.I.1.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise registration: Obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) of the provincial DPI or the IZA Management Board, acting through the National Business Registration Portal at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after the IRC is issued, the investor (or authorized agent) files the Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1) electronically, together with the Company Charter (Form I-2), the List of Members (Form I-4), and the notarized identity documents of all members. The application must state the principal business lines as 'Securities and other financial service activities, including proprietary trading and market making' (ISIC 6499, conditional business line). The Business Registration Office performs formal and legality screening and issues the ERC within 3 working days of electronic receipt of a complete dossier. The ERC simultaneously allocates the enterprise tax identification number and automatically notifies the tax, statistics, and social insurance authorities.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1)
Company Charter (Form I-2) executed by all members
List of members (Form I-4) reflecting each member's subscribed capital contribution
Notarized copies of passports or certificates of incorporation of all member individuals/entities
Legal documents of corporate members (charter, certificate of incorporation, resolution authorizing the subscription)
Investment Registration Certificate issued under Step 1
Written consent of members to the proposed enterprise name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed enterprise name is rejected, the applicant selects a compliant alternative name and resubmits; if the dossier contains deficiencies, the Business Registration Office notifies the applicant once through the portal and the applicant has a supplementary period (typically 15 days) to cure; repeated failure to cure results in an electronic rejection letter which may be appealed to the Director of the DPI or to the competent administrative court, and the standard remedy is a corrected resubmission within the appeal window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital contribution and escrow, bank account opening, corporate seal, and tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Vietnam (capital contribution and escrow account); provincial/city Tax Department and the General Department of Taxation's eTax portal (tax registration and license fee); Business Registration Office via the National Business Registration Portal (seal specimen notification).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 90 days of the ERC, all members must contribute their subscribed charter capital in full in lawful convertible currency. The General Director opens a dedicated capital-contribution escrow account in the Company's name; each member wires its committed amount with a clear remittance reference; the bank issues a capital-contribution confirmation certificate to be preserved in the corporate records and later exhibited to the State Securities Commission. Concurrently, the Company engraves its corporate seal, notifies the seal specimen through the National Business Registration Portal under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, completes tax registration using Form 01/ĐK-TCT via the eTax portal, registers for electronic invoicing, and files the annual license fee (lệ phí môn bài) declaration with the managing tax authority.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Board of Members resolution approving the contribution schedule and escrow arrangement
Bank account opening application, source-of-funds declaration, and eKYC documentation of the legal representative
Capital contribution confirmation certificate issued by the escrow bank
Corporate seal carving certificate and seal specimen notification form
Tax registration declaration (Form 01/ĐK-TCT) and license fee (môn bài) declaration
Electronic invoice registration application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank defers account opening pending enhanced AML due diligence, the Company must supply audited financial statements of the members, a source-of-funds explanatory note, and the beneficial-owner register; if a member fails to contribute capital on time, the Company must impose the statutory interest sanction under the Company Charter, and the contribution obligation remains enforceable until full contribution, with late contribution or non-contribution subject to administrative penalties under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; the alternative cure is a lawful reduction of charter capital approved by the Board of Members and refiled with the Business Registration Office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the Securities Company Establishment and Operation License from the State Securities Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Securities Commission of Vietnam (UBCKNN) under the Ministry of Finance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company files a formal written license application to the State Securities Commission under Articles 145-146 of Decree 155/2020/ND-CP for the scope 'Proprietary Securities Trading and Securities Market Making'. The dossier must include the organization and operation plan, the algorithmic trading and information-technology system architecture (including ultra-low-latency co-location design, order-flow segregation, kill-switch and pre-trade risk controls), the internal risk-management and compliance regulations, evidence of minimum charter capital VND 500 billion escrowed in Vietnam, and the professional qualifications of the executive officers and traders. The SSC appraises the full dossier and issues the license within 90 days of the date of a complete and valid application; no proprietary trading activity may commence before the license is issued.
required_dossiers: Written license application addressed to the State Securities Commission
Notarized copies of the Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate
Charter capital contribution evidence and bank capital-contribution confirmation certificate
Organization and operation plan approved by the Board of Members
Business plan for proprietary algorithmic market-making with projected liquidity provision
Detailed information-technology and trading system description, including co-location, ultra-low-latency network, hardware and security architecture
Internal regulations on risk management, compliance, information security, business continuity, and anti-money laundering/counter-terrorism financing
Curriculum vitae, professional securities certificates and criminal-record certificates of the General Director, Chief Compliance Officer, Chief Risk Officer and proposed traders
Audited financial statements of the Company or founding members, as applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Under Article 147 of Decree 155/2020/ND-CP, the SSC must issue a written supplementary request listing all deficiencies within a defined period; the Company has 30 days to submit supplementary documents; if the license is refused, the Company may file a complaint with the Chairman of the State Securities Commission and further to the Ministry of Finance, or initiate an administrative court action; the effective remedy is to cure the deficiencies in the risk-management, IT, or capital-adequacy area and resubmit, or to narrow the requested license scope to proprietary trading only.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Connect to market infrastructure: VSDC clearing membership, HOSE/HNX exchange membership, and payment system readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (VSDC/VSD); Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HOSE); Hanoi Stock Exchange (HNX); State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) and the interbank electronic payment system (IBPS) as the direct exchange clearing and settlement rail.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Securities Company Establishment and Operation License, the Company must apply for clearing membership with the VSDC for securities and cash settlement, obtain exchange membership on HOSE and/or HNX, execute the market-making commitment agreements, subscribe to co-location services and real-time market-data feeds, and connect to the SBV interbank electronic payment system (the Vietnamese functional equivalent of Fedwire for the target payment rails 'Direct_Exchange_Clearing' and 'Fedwire'). The ultra-low-latency trading system must pass end-to-end exchange certification tests covering latency, message throughput, pre-trade risk controls, kill-switch operability, and anomalous-trading detection; a live-readiness certificate and test report must be submitted to the SSC within 10 business days of such certification.
required_dossiers: Securities Company Establishment and Operation License
VSDC clearing-member registration application and settlement participation agreement
HOSE/HNX membership application and market-making commitment/performance guarantee documents
Co-location order forms and market-data subscription agreements with the exchanges
Trading system certification test report (latency measurement, risk-control and kill-switch test results)
List of traders and order-entry operators holding applicable professional certificates
SSC-approved custody arrangement and SBV IBPS access application
Business continuity and disaster-recovery plan for the trading floor and co-location site
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If exchange membership is deferred pending remediation of trading-system findings, the Company must implement the required controls and resubmit the certification report; if VSDC rejects the clearing membership, the Company may appeal to the State Securities Commission within 15 working days; as a temporary remedy the Company may execute trades through a licensed clearing sponsor while completing clearing membership, provided such sponsorship structure is approved by the SSC.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Securities Commission of Vietnam (UBCKNN) under the Ministry of Finance for the securities operating license; the Management Board of the Export Processing and Industrial Zone (IZA) or the provincial Department of Construction and Department of Natural Resources and Environment for physical-facility and environmental certification within or outside EPE/IZ areas.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Securities Company Establishment and Operation License (Giấy phép thành lập và hoạt động công ty chứng khoán) covering the licensed activities of proprietary securities trading and securities market making; supplemented by the VSDC clearing-membership certificate and the HOSE/HNX exchange membership certificate for algorithmic high-frequency market-making operations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment of Vietnam (MONRE), delegated to the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for small-scale/office-based projects; where the office or co-location site sits inside an export processing or industrial zone, the IZA Management Board acts as the receiving authority for environmental registration under Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III - Mandatory Environmental Registration (Đăng ký môi trường) under Articles 49, 58 and 59 of the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP. A Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is NOT required for an office-based algorithmic trading company that has no industrial production process, no significant point-source discharge of industrial wastewater, and no large-volume hazardous-waste generation; however, an environmental registration certificate must be obtained and filed with the local DONRE or IZA before the office/trading floor is put into operation, and the certificate must be renewed upon any material change in facility scale or activity type.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance thresholds applicable to the trading office, co-location room and support facilities: (i) domestic wastewater from kitchen and sanitary facilities must be treated on-site and meet QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT limits on BOD5, TSS, ammonia, nitrate and coliforms before discharge to the municipal sewer; (ii) ambient air quality at the facility boundary must comply with QCVN 05:2023/BTNMT for PM2.5, PM10, NO2 and SO2; (iii) noise levels must not exceed 70 dBA during daytime and 55 dBA at night per QCVN 26:2016/BTNMT; (iv) electromagnetic field exposure in server rooms and co-location areas must comply with QCVN 21:2016/BTNMT for EMF safety; (v) backup generator exhaust emissions must satisfy QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT industrial emission limits for particulate matter, NOx, SO2 and CO; (vi) solid waste must be segregated, and hazardous e-waste (UPS batteries, server components) must be declared, stored and transferred to licensed hazardous-waste treatment facilities in accordance with Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP and QCVN 07:2009/BTNMT hazardous-waste thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certification: prior to operational use of the trading floor, server/co-location rooms and offices, the Company must obtain the Fire Prevention and Fighting System Acceptance Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận thẩm duyệt thiết kế và nghiệm thu về phòng cháy chữa cháy) issued by the provincial Police Department of Fire Prevention and Rescue under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP, including design appraisal, installation acceptance testing, and operational fire-safety certification with annual in-house fire-team drills. Structural Load Certification: a licensed inspection agency must certify that the floor loading of co-location/server rooms and trading floors meets the design rack loads and equipment weights, with a certificate of structural safety issued by the provincial construction authority. Occupational Health and Safety Clearance: the Company must complete a workplace risk assessment, electrical installation safety certification, emergency evacuation planning, and appointment of an occupational safety and health (OSH) officer in accordance with the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13 and its implementing decrees, and maintain annual OSH training records for all trading and operations staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) of the Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam; national online portal: etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn (National Tax Portal / Cổng thông tin điện tử của Tổng cục Thuế)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested limited liability company must obtain a Tax Identification Number (MST) via the enterprise registration process administered by the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) and the GDT. The procedure is integrated with the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and Investment Registration Certificate (IRC). Steps: (1) file an online application with the DPI through the National Business Registration Portal (vanban.gov.vn / dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) including the company charter, list of members, legal representative identification, and capital contribution schedules; (2) upon issuance of the ERC, the GDT automatically allocates a 13-digit TIN/MST to the enterprise; (3) the LLC must then complete a tax registration dossier (Form 03-DK-TCT) updating supplementary tax information (bank accounts, authorized accounting officer, and tax agent appointments) within 15 business days; (4) foreign contractors or offshore principals with Vietnamese-sourced income are separately registered under withholding registration or may rely on local withholding by Vietnamese counterparts; (5) the LLC must obtain an electronic signature (USB token) for e-invoicing and declare tax via eTax or the GDT's HTKK offline software, after being activated by the local tax sub-department.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam does not operate a check-the-box classification system analogous to the U.S. regime. There are no elective pass-through classifications for corporate LLCs. A foreign-invested LLC is mandatorily subject to enterprise income tax (CIT) at entity level. Available elections and special regimes include: (i) election to apply for high-tech enterprise income tax incentives (10% CIT rate for 15 years, plus 4-year CIT exemption and 9-year 50% reduction) subject to meeting statutory conditions; (ii) election to apply investment project incentive certificates under the Law on Investment and Decree 218/2013/ND-CP, as amended; (iii) group consolidation election for related-party tax determination is not permitted; (iv) for hybrid mismatch purposes, Vietnam has no elective rules and follows substance-over-form, but taxpayers may elect to carry forward tax losses (maximum 5 years) with no carryback; (v) VAT election: an enterprise may elect the deduction method (the compulsory method for LLCs above the threshold) versus the direct method (applied to smaller enterprises, foreign contractors, and certain trading activities) — a foreign-invested LLC with standard accounting books must use the deduction method. Transfer pricing and permanent establishment rules apply mandatorily; no check-the-box hybrid branch/entity elections exist under Vietnamese domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax / Thuế giá trị gia tăng)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 100,000,000 annual revenue from taxable goods and services (prior to 1 July 2024; under the amended VAT Law effective 1 July 2025, the increased registration threshold is VND 200,000,000 annual revenue except for business households and individuals with lower thresholds under Government guidance). Foreign suppliers that have revenue derived from Vietnam, including cross-border digital services, must register, declare, and pay VAT through the GDT's Foreign Supplier Portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn) if annual revenue from Vietnam exceeds VND 100,000,000 or under the revised threshold of VND 200,000,000 effective July 2025, regardless of whether a local permanent establishment exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vietnam mandates a mandatory e-invoicing system effective 1 July 2022 (Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC). Invoices must be generated in XML format compliant with the GDT's standard data schema, signed with a digital signature (or a digital stamp affixed via an authorized intermediary), and transmitted to the GDT's e-invoice portal for validation and assignment of a unique invoice number. The GDT operates two modes: (i) offline e-invoice (without a real-time two-way API clearance) used by businesses selling to consumers; and (ii) online e-invoice with real-time data transmission to the GDT portal providing a tax authority code/approval number before issuance to the buyer, required for sales to state organizations and for regulated sectors. A foreign-invested LLC engaged in proprietary HFT activities (not making direct B2C supplies) must nonetheless connect through the GDT's API/eTax infrastructure for monthly VAT declarations; there is no physical fiscal stamping, but each invoice must show a QR code containing authentication data. Special fiscal receipts for securities transactions are not classified as VAT invoices; brokerage/clearing-related fees are subject to VAT under the standard service rules. Electronic invoices must be stored for 6 years and archived on servers located in Vietnam or accessible via authenticated channels to the GDT upon request.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export zero-rating under the Vietnamese VAT Law applies only to goods exported from Vietnam (including exports processed, manufactured, or sold to foreign entities and physically exported out of Vietnam) and services supplied to foreign organizations/individuals and consumed outside Vietnam (offshore services). Proprietary algorithmic trading services rendered by a Vietnamese LLC to overseas counterparties with no Vietnamese consumption, substantiated by contracts and evidence that the services are provided and used outside Vietnam, may qualify for 0% VAT provided the taxpayer holds valid export documentation. Specifically, VAT zero-rating is available for exported goods and export services (including technical services, information technology services, and offshore financial trading services) under Article 9 of Decree 209/2013/ND-CP and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC, provided that: (i) the taxpayer has an export contract; (ii) the exported goods/services are actually delivered out of Vietnam; (iii) the taxpayer possesses a customs export declaration for goods; for services, a written contract with a foreign party, proof of payment from foreign currency, and documentation evidencing consumption outside Vietnam are required; and (iv) the taxpayer has not claimed input VAT credit attributable to domestic supplies. Financial derivative and HFT transaction services are treated as export services only if the recipient is non-resident, the services are not connected to Vietnamese immovable property or goods, and the service is physically or legally performed/consumed outside Vietnam; Vietnam's Law on Tax Administration requires the service provider to obtain a letter of non-tax residence or a certificate of tax residency from the foreign counterpart if applying the 0% rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Tờ khai hải quan điện tử) with customs clearance stamp, printed from the Vietnam Automated Cargo and Port Consolidated System (VNACCS/VCIS)
Commercial Invoice issued by the Vietnamese LLC
Bill of Lading (Master and/or House B/L) evidencing physical export from Vietnam
Packing List and proof of actual shipment from Vietnamese territory
Export Contract / Sales Agreement signed by the parties

Inward Remittance Certificate (Xác nhận thanh toán qua ngân hàng / Giấy báo có) confirming receipt of export proceeds in a freely convertible foreign currency via an authorized Vietnamese commercial bank within 360 days (export payment term deadline) except for permitted offshore processing arrangements
Certificate of origin (C/O) or other documentary proof where required by the importing jurisdiction

Service delivery report / acceptance certificate signed by the non-resident customer evidencing that the algorithmic trading services were consumed outside Vietnam, and where applicable a certificate of tax residence of the foreign party to support the zero-rated export service treatment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under Vietnam's tax administration regime, fraudulent zero-rating or refund claims trigger severe exposure under Law No. 38/2019/QH14 (Law on Tax Administration), Decree 125/2020/ND-CP (sanctions for tax and invoice violations), and the Penal Code (No. 100/2015/QH13 as amended). Consequences include: (i) retrospective clawback of the entire zero-rated benefit and any VAT refund already received, plus interest accrued at the rate of 0.03% per day (0.5% per month) from the date the refund was wrongfully obtained; (ii) administrative penalties ranging from 1 to 3 times the evaded amount (up to 20 million VND up to 1.5 times for procedural violations, and from 1 to 3 times for under-declaration/evasion); (iii) a late-payment interest charge of 0.03% per day on outstanding amounts; (iv) suspension of e-invoicing status, tax registration revocation, and public disclosure of non-compliant taxpayers; (v) criminal prosecution for fraudulent VAT refunds/evasion (offences involving VND 100 million or more in evaded tax, or VND 200 million or more in fraudulent refunds) carrying fines up to 4.5 billion VND and/or imprisonment from 6 months up to 20 years for organized or especially large fraud; (vi) statutory limitation periods for tax inspection and retroactive assessments are extended to 10 years for acts concerning fraud or evasion of tax, and unlimited time for refund clawback in cases of forged documentation or false declarations; (vii) managers and legal representatives may be personally jointly liable, and a finding of intentional misdeclaration blocks mitigating penalties and prevents the taxpayer from accessing future tax incentive statuses or investment license renewals.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) — Ngan Hang Nha Nuoc Viet Nam
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese dong (VND) operates under a managed-floating regime with partial convertibility. Current-account operations, including trade settlement, service payments, and permitted transfers, are generally freely convertible through licensed credit institutions. Capital-account operations—such as foreign equity contributions, shareholder loans, and cross-border financing—remain subject to SBV licensing, registration, and strict routing through a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at a licensed Vietnamese bank. Profit remittance abroad is permitted annually after corporate income tax finalization and audited financial statements are filed; no discrete SBV approval is required once tax obligations are satisfied and remittance formalities are completed. All foreign investment capital inflows and outflows must match the investment registration certificate and be tracked through DICA, with foreign-currency equity contributions subject to exchange-rate conversion risk. Full capital-account liberalisation is not implemented, and the SBV retains reserve powers to impose emergency surrender or repatriation restrictions during balance-of-payments stress.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Decree 70/2014/ND-CP and related SBV implementing circulars (notably Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN), Vietnamese exporters must repatriate export proceeds into a licensed bank account in Vietnam within 180 days of the export transaction/collection date. The current mandatory surrender ratio for ordinary export receipts is 0% following the gradual abolition of the historical 80–100% conversion mechanism; exporters may retain foreign currency in an authorised foreign-currency account for permitted uses, provided they comply with SBV reporting and bank-account discipline requirements. The SBV retains the legal authority to reintroduce partial or full surrender obligations temporarily under severe external-imbalance or foreign-reserve-depletion scenarios, and such emergency conversion ratios would apply across export receipts unless a statutory exemption is granted.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA); Operational VND and foreign-currency accounts

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA); Operational VND and foreign-currency accounts

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA); Operational VND and foreign-currency accounts

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: TECHCOMBANK (Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA); Operational VND and foreign-currency accounts; corporate treasury sweep

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. Offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as digital cross-border platforms do not hold an SBV authorised-entity licence and cannot open a DICA or perform VND clearing through Vietnam's national payment infrastructure. They may be used only for ancillary non-VND treasury flows and are wholly unsuitable for statutory foreign-invested-entity banking (equity injections, shareholder-loan servicing, profit remittance, export receipt collection). Vietnamese forex and tax authorities will not recognise unlicensed EMI settlement for regulatory compliance; all regulated capital and current-account movements must remain inside the licensed banking system. Any attempted routing of inbound capital or outbound repatriation through an offshore EMI would expose the group to AML/KYC rejection, SBV administrative penalties, and corporate income tax/foreign-exchange reclassification risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is required for corporate account opening at licensed Vietnamese banks. The legal representative and each authorised signatory must appear in person before a bank officer at a branch in Vietnam for original signature specimen, identity verification, and an AML/EDD interview. Remote opening is not available for offshore directors without a prior physical presence in the Vietnamese jurisdiction. In exceptional cases, a Vietnamese notary or a Vietnamese commercial attaché may assist in verifying documents abroad, but SBV-recognised KYC norms still require the final interview and account activation inside Vietnam. For foreign-owned trading entities, the bank will additionally require a certified copy of the Investment Registration Certificate, Enterprise Registration Certificate, consularised corporate resolutions, passport copies, and a power-of-attorney for each signatory not physically attend.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency cross-border wire transfers with sub-second algorithmic execution and a high number of low-ticket-size transfers, generating abnormal velocity alerts under SBV transaction-monitoring thresholds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Algorithmic order-execution log and pre-trade risk-control report; signed ISDA/clearing agreements with each regulated liquidity venue; daily transaction reconciliation and average ticket-size report; source-of-funds statement; custodian bank confirmation of trade-specific settlement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) structure involving shell-prone jurisdictions, economic-passport citizenship, or opaque multi-layer holding entities precipitating source-of-wealth review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Organisational chart with look-through to natural-person UBOs; notarised and consularised UBO declaration; copy of economic passport and proof of tax residence; bank reference letters from previous tier-1 financial institutions; external auditor certification of the corporate group.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Financial statements reflect robust proprietary trading profits with minimal physical substance, triggering suspicion of unreported foreign-exchange or tax obligations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements under Vietnamese GAAP/IFRS prepared by a licensed Vietnamese audit firm; tax finalization certificates and proof of corporate income tax payments; Investment Registration Certificate evidencing authorised trading scope; internal control and enterprise-risk-management policy; reconciliation between trading profit and forex remittances completed by an independent accountant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or SDN fuzzy matches on counterparties, clearing venues, or beneficial owners, producing name-flag hits in the bank's automated screening engine.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated sanctions-screening log showing resolved false-positive hits; legal opinion (Vietnamese counsel) confirming no restricted-party nexus; counterparty compliance declarations; SWIFT records evidencing that all transfers were completed through licensed banks in strictly tracked DICA or operational foreign-currency accounts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injections and shareholder loans must be transmitted via SWIFT MT103/MT202 with full sender/receiver identification to the DICA maintained with an SBV-licensed commercial bank. The remittance instruction must include the Investment Registration Certificate identification number, and the bank must record the transfer against the statutory capital-disbursement schedule. Purpose codes should identify 'direct investment capital contribution' or 'shareholder loan', and all boarding will verify the funding via the investor's audited financial statements and the underlying investment licence. The SBV requires that the DICA be used for all inward direct-investment capital flows; conversion to VND may occur onshore at the bank's daily dealing rate. Any excess capital injections beyond the registered charter-capital schedule require an amended Investment Registration Certificate before completion.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury disbursements for proprietary HFT market making will predominantly clear via the DICA or the operational foreign-currency account through SWIFT MT103 (single payments), MT202 (bank-to-bank transfers), or MT700 / documentary credit mechanisms under UCP600 where collateralised trade financing is employed. International payments will be settled through correspondent bank relationships, including Fedwire, CHIPS, and TARGET2, using SWIFT AA/CO messages and conforming to each recipient's AML/OFAC requirements. Commercial letters of credit are permissible only for goods-based settlements; for algorithmic trading collateral and margin returns, the standard clearing rail is MT103/202 with full 16-character settlement references to the ultimate exposure site, accompanied by daily margin statements from the clearing broker to the treasury desk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OTC VND/USD forward contracts executed with an SBV-licensed bank, based on a documented underlying current or capital transaction.
Onshore FX swaps and cross-currency swaps with an authorised Vietnamese credit institution, used to match short-term VND/USD funding and DICA conversion effects.
Plain-vanilla VND/USD foreign-exchange options provided they are underwritten by a bank holding an SBV derivative licence and the hedge is traceable to a commercial exposure.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible onshore for Vietnamese residents; any synthetic offshore NDF must be avoided due to SBV capital-control and VAT/tax-opacity risks.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Taxation under the General Department of Taxation, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the 31 December fiscal year-end (within 90 calendar days after year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 2,000,000 to VND 6,000,000 for late or inaccurate filing; repeated non-filing for over 12 months may trigger forced administrative dissolution and strike-off of the enterprise registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax finalisation return (Quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Taxation supervising the LLC's tax residence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty from VND 4,000,000 to VND 100,000,000; late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on the unpaid CIT amount; persistent default for 12 months may result in tax enforcement and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual investment activity report (Báo cáo hoạt động đầu tư)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment; Foreign Investment Agency under the national investment reporting system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 January of the following calendar year (within 30 days after the calendar-year reporting date)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of up to VND 30,000,000 for failure to submit or for incorrect annual investment data; material non-compliance for over 12 consecutive months may lead the investment registration agency to initiate dissolution proceedings and certificate revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory independent audit report (mandatory for foreign-invested LLC and licensed trading entity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Audit report is submitted together with the annual financial statements to the provincial tax authorities and included in the DPI annual investment report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit must be completed and accompany the annual financial statements no later than 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Financial statements without a mandatory audit are treated as incomplete; the tax authority may impose default assessment penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, and continuous absence of audit reports may trigger administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Securities/trading licence annual compliance and financial report (algorithmic high-frequency trading entity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Securities Commission of Vietnam (as the statutory licensing authority for proprietary trading activity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end (on or before 31 March) or the licence-specific audited filing date, whichever is earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Warning and fines up to VND 200,000,000 for late or incomplete compliance reports; continued non-filing may suspend the trading licence and require closure of trading access, with eventual administrative strike-off for prolonged dormancy.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Any 100% foreign-invested limited liability company and any holder of a securities/trading licence in Vietnam is subject to a mandatory annual independent audit; size thresholds do not waive this obligation, and the audit must be performed by a Vietnamese-licensed independent audit firm.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) constitute the statutory local GAAP; corporate accounting is governed by Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC. IFRS may be used only as supplementary consolidated or parent-entity presentation where permitted; all statutory filings must be prepared under VAS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not maintain a public UBO registry. The LLC must record every shareholding or capital transfer in the company's member register and reflect ownership changes in the annual investment activity report to the Department of Planning and Investment. Under AML/CFT law (Decree 156/2019/ND-CP as amended), the LLC must conduct an annual internal UBO review and update beneficial-ownership records, making them available to the State Bank of Vietnam upon request; there is no standalone public UBO annual return, but transfers must be confirmed in the DPI periodic report.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Board of Management and Control (if constituted)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard statutory CIT rate of 20% applies to the proprietary high-frequency trading entity. No generic incentive applies to electronic trading or proprietary financial services. Sector-specific incentives under Decree 218/2013/ND-CP and associated regulations are limited to qualifying high-tech enterprises, software production, and enterprises in industrial zones/economic zones; these are generally not available for dedicated algorithm trading, but may be considered if the entity also performs qualifying software development activities. This whitepaper assumes the standard 20% headline rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual CIT finalisation return: Form 03/TNDN (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN); quarterly provisional returns: Form 02/TNDN. All submissions and payments are processed through the electronic tax portal of the General Department of Taxation (eTax / thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly provisional filings and annual finalisation filing
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly CIT declarations and provisional payments are due within 30 days after the end of each quarter. The annual CIT finalisation return must be submitted within 90 days after the end of the fiscal year. A 90-day payment deadline applies to the final assessed tax amount.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification: taxpayer name, tax identification number, accounting period, address, authorised representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the Vietnamese tax identification number and, where applicable, the foreign parent company name and tax identification reference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue lines: sales revenue, service revenue, gain on financial instruments, other income, and income from non-resident sources.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report income effectively arising in Vietnam from proprietary trading activities. Include detailed schedules for algorithmic trading profits and mark-to-market adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions: direct costs, indirect costs, depreciation, employee expenses, and other allowable expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure that cross-border service charges (data licences, hosting, market access) are supported by valid contracts, invoices, and evidence of actual service delivery in Vietnam to satisfy deductibility requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of taxable income: assessable income after deductions and loss carryforward, applicable tax rate, and CIT payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the standard 20% rate. Foreign tax credits, if any, are declared in the supporting schedules, not as deductions from gross revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attachments: related-party transaction disclosure forms, tax loss carryforward schedule, overseas tax credit schedule, and financial statement confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Furnish the related-party transaction form (Phụ lục I/II/III) for all transactions with non-resident affiliates, irrespective of whether the transfer pricing documentation threshold is met.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP range from VND 3 million to VND 10 million per infraction depending on the delay period. In addition, late payment interest is charged at 0.03% per day on the outstanding tax amount. Under-declaration or false declaration may result in additional penalties of 20% to 100% of the underpaid tax, up to 3 times the evaded amount, plus criminal prosecution where applicable.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for non-resident corporate shareholders; 5% for non-resident individual shareholders. Dividends distributed out of after-tax profits to a foreign juridical owner are not subject to further corporate income tax withholding in Vietnam.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Double Tax Agreement (DTA), the beneficial owner must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the competent authority of its residence jurisdiction. The TRC, together with the DTA application form (Form 01/HTBT) and the underlying payment contract, is submitted to the Vietnamese tax authority before or at the time of payment through the electronic tax portal. The approved DTA rate is applied during withholding. A separate TRC is required for each calendar year and payment stream.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on royalty payments to non-residents is 10%; interest paid to non-residents is subject to a 5% withholding tax. Under applicable DTAs, the rates are frequently reduced to 5% for royalties and 5% for interest (some treaties reduce interest to 10%). The treaty reduction is conditional on submission of the TRC and compliance with beneficial ownership requirements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, a Vietnamese entity is required to prepare a Local File if the total value of related-party transactions exceeds VND 30 billion in a tax year, or if the entity earns total consolidated revenue of more than VND 50 billion and its related-party lending value exceeds VND 20 billion. The Master File threshold applies when the group's consolidated revenue exceeds VND 1 trillion. Exceptions apply for entities with nil related-party transactions or those satisfying the de minimis exemptions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not have a standalone Economic Substance Regulations regime comparable to UAE ESR. Nevertheless, the tax administration applies substance-based anti-avoidance rules: the place of effective management doctrine, the beneficial ownership test, and general anti-avoidance provisions under the Tax Administration Law. A limited liability company with no physical office, employees, or substantive decision-making for its trading algorithms may be treated as a shell and disregarded for tax purposes, subject to re-characterisation and denial of treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately underreporting proprietary trading profits, inflating deductible expenses, creating invoices for fictitious services, or concealing trading revenues through offshore shell entities without any economic activity in Vietnam.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, the penalty for tax evasion is between 1 and 3 times the underpaid tax amount. Criminal liability is triggered under Article 200 of the Penal Code 2015 (amended 2017) where the evaded amount exceeds VND 100 million; sanctions include fines of VND 300 million to VND 1 billion and imprisonment for up to 7 years. Corporate sanctions are accompanied by judicial dissolution in serious cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced where directors or legal representatives participated in, authorised, or had knowledge of the fraudulent acts. Directors may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes and civil restitution. A court may issue travel bans, passport seizures, and asset freezes, and directors face individual criminal prosecution and disqualification from management positions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering the LLC in Vietnam solely to obtain tax advantages, dividend repatriation flows, or artificial invoice issuance without conducting actual trading activity, maintaining an office, having employees, or exercising genuine management controls over the algorithmic trading systems.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may deny the entity's existence, recharacterise all transactions at the level of the parent company, disallow loss carryforwards, and impose penalties for underpaid tax. Under the Law on Enterprises 2020, the business registration certificate may be revoked for enterprises operating beyond their registered purpose or engaging in fraudulent registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable under civil law for the company's unpaid taxes when the shell structure is deemed an abuse of limited liability. Criminal prosecution for fraud, tax evasion, or money laundering may be pursued against individual directors, including imprisonment, travel restrictions, and confiscation of personal assets used in the scheme.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer pricing non-compliance and false reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a Local File, Master File, or country-by-country report where thresholds are met; submitting incomplete related-party transaction schedules; or applying a non-arm's-length price to algorithmic trading, data licensing, or intellectual property licensing transactions with affiliates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, failure to provide transfer pricing documentation attracts an administrative fine of up to VND 40 million. The tax authority may independently re-determine the taxpayer's profit by reference to comparable third-party data and impose an additional assessment. The shortfall may be subject to penalties of 20% to 50% of the additional tax assessed, plus interest at 0.03% per day.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve incorrect transfer pricing documentation or intentionally falsify related-party transaction disclosures may be treated as joint participants in tax evasion, attracting criminal liability under Article 200 of the Penal Code. They may additionally be subject to civil claims for the shortfall suffered by the company and be barred from acting as directors in Vietnam.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating high-frequency trading without implementing required AML/CFT internal controls, failing to conduct customer due diligence in jurisdictions used for the corporate vehicle, concealing ownership beneficiaries, or failing to report unusual transactions linked to the proprietary trading platform where the activity is subjected to financial market supervision.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering (Law 20/2022/QH15), failure to implement AML procedures can lead to administrative fines in the range of VND 50 million to VND 500 million for the company. Regulatory and criminal authorities may suspend the trading licence or withdraw securities and derivatives licences. If the entity facilitates money laundering, separate criminal sanctions apply under the Penal Code, including fines up to VND 2 billion and imprisonment of responsible individuals for up to 15 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers of the LLC have a statutory duty to establish adequate AML controls. Personal liability arises for civil damages caused by the company's laundering activity where the director failed to act in good faith or knowingly facilitated illicit flows. Travel bans and issuance restrictions can be imposed pending criminal proceedings, and directors may be prosecuted for money laundering in addition to the company's sanctions.
